+extends Area2D
+class_name Ball
+
+signal bounced
+signal missed
+
+@export var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2(0, 200)
+@export var gravity: float = 300.0
+@export var angular_velocity: float = 5.0
+
+onready var sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite2D
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Connect to area entered to detect paddle collisions
+    connect("area_entered", Callable(self, "_on_area_entered"))
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # Apply gravity
+    velocity.y += gravity * delta
+    position += velocity * delta
+    # Spin
+    rotation += angular_velocity * delta
+
+    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
+    var r = 16
+    # Wall collisions (left/right)
+    if position.x < r:
+        position.x = r
+        velocity.x = abs(velocity.x)
+    elif position.x > view_size.x - r:
+        position.x = view_size.x - r
+        velocity.x = -abs(velocity.x)
+    # Top
+    if position.y < r:
+        position.y = r
+        velocity.y = abs(velocity.y)
+    # Missed (fell below screen)
+    if position.y > view_size.y + 32:
+        emit_signal("missed")
+        queue_free()
+

+    if area.name == "Paddle":
+        # Only bounce if moving downward

+            # reflect upward

+            # Add sideways influence based on contact point
+            var offset = position.x - area.global_position.x
+            velocity.x += offset * 3.0
+            # Slight spin change
+            angular_velocity += offset * 0.01
+            emit_signal("bounced")
+

+    return true
+

+    position = pos
+    velocity = vel
+    rotation = 0

--- game/main.gd

@@ -0,0 +1,187 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+# Main game controller for Bounce Catch
+
+const WIN_SCORE: int = 15
+
+var score: int = 0
+var lives: int = 3
+var state: String = "playing" # "playing", "win", "game_over"
+var balls: Array = []
+
+var PaddleScene = preload("res://paddle.tscn")
+var BallScene = preload("res://ball.tscn")
+
+onready var spawn_timer: Timer = Timer.new()
+onready var hud_layer: CanvasLayer = CanvasLayer.new()
+onready var score_label: Label = Label.new()
+onready var lives_label: Label = Label.new()
+onready var message_label: Label = Label.new()
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # Window title
+    if Engine.has_singleton("OS"):
+        OS.set_window_title("Bounce Catch")
+
+    randomize()
+
+    # Ensure input actions
+    if not InputMap.has_action("move_left"):
+        InputMap.add_action("move_left")
+    var ev = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev)
+    var ev2 = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev2.physical_keycode = KEY_A
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_left", ev2)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("move_right"):
+        InputMap.add_action("move_right")
+    var ev3 = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev3.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev3)
+    var ev4 = InputEventKey.new()
+    ev4.physical_keycode = KEY_D
+    InputMap.action_add_event("move_right", ev4)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
+        InputMap.add_action("restart")
+    var evr = InputEventKey.new()
+    evr.physical_keycode = KEY_R
+    InputMap.action_add_event("restart", evr)
+
+    if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
+        InputMap.add_action("quit")
+    var evq = InputEventKey.new()
+    evq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
+    InputMap.action_add_event("quit", evq)
+
+    # Create paddle and place near bottom center
+    var paddle = PaddleScene.instantiate()
+    paddle.name = "Paddle"
+    add_child(paddle)
+    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
+    paddle.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2, view_size.y - 48)
+
+    # Setup HUD
+    hud_layer.name = "HUD"
+    add_child(hud_layer)
+
+    score_label.name = "ScoreLabel"
+    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
+    score_label.position = Vector2(10, 10)
+    hud_layer.add_child(score_label)
+
+    lives_label.name = "LivesLabel"
+    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives
+    lives_label.position = Vector2(10, 34)
+    hud_layer.add_child(lives_label)
+
+    message_label.name = "MessageLabel"
+    message_label.text = ""
+    message_label.position = Vector2(view_size.x/2 - 60, view_size.y/2 - 20)
+    message_label.visible = false
+    hud_layer.add_child(message_label)
+
+    # Spawn timer
+    spawn_timer.one_shot = false
+    spawn_timer.wait_time = 1.0
+    spawn_timer.autostart = true
+    spawn_timer.name = "SpawnTimer"
+    add_child(spawn_timer)
+    spawn_timer.start()
+    spawn_timer.timeout.connect(Callable(self, "_on_spawn_timer_timeout"))
+
+    # Start game state
+    score = 0
+    lives = 3
+    state = "playing"
+    update_hud()
+
+func _on_spawn_timer_timeout() -> void:
+    if state != "playing":
+        return
+    spawn_ball()
+
+func spawn_ball() -> void:
+    var view_size = get_viewport_rect().size
+    var b = BallScene.instantiate()
+    b.position = Vector2(randf_range(16, view_size.x - 16), 16)
+    # Give a small random horizontal velocity
+    b.velocity = Vector2(randf_range(-50, 50), 40)
+    add_child(b)
+    balls.append(b)
+    b.add_to_group("balls")
+    # Connect signals
+    if not b.is_connected("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced")):
+        b.connect("bounced", Callable(self, "_on_ball_bounced"), [b])
+    if not b.is_connected("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed")):
+        b.connect("missed", Callable(self, "_on_ball_missed"), [b])
+
+func _on_ball_bounced(ball: Node) -> void:
+    if state != "playing":
+        return
+    score += 1
+    update_hud()
+    # Ensure the ball is tracked
+    if balls.has(ball) == false:
+        balls.append(ball)
+    if score >= WIN_SCORE:
+        handle_win()
+
+func _on_ball_missed(ball: Node) -> void:
+    if state != "playing":
+        return
+    # Remove from tracking if present
+    if balls.has(ball):
+        balls.erase(ball)
+    lives -= 1
+    update_hud()
+    if lives <= 0:
+        handle_game_over()
+
+func handle_win() -> void:
+    if state == "win":
+        return
+    state = "win"
+    spawn_timer.stop()
+    message_label.text = "WIN"
+    message_label.visible = true
+    print("WIN")
+    print("SCORE:", score)
+
+func handle_game_over() -> void:
+    if state == "game_over":
+        return
+    state = "game_over"
+    spawn_timer.stop()
+    message_label.text = "GAME OVER"
+    message_label.visible = true
+    print("GAME OVER")
+    print("SCORE:", score)
+
+func update_hud() -> void:
+    score_label.text = "Score: %d" % score
+    lives_label.text = "Lives: %d" % lives
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # Restart or quit handling
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+        restart_game()
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+        get_tree().quit()
+
+func restart_game() -> void:
+    # Only perform full reset if not playing, or always allow restart
+    # Clear existing balls
+    for b in balls.duplicate():
+        if is_instance_valid(b):
+            b.queue_free()
+    balls.clear()
+    # Reset state
+    score = 0
+    lives = 3
+    state = "playing"
+    message_label.visible = false
+    update_hud()
+    spawn_timer.start()

initial_build_notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement ownership:
  - 0 (title): game/project.godot (application name) and game/main.gd (OS window title).
  - 1,2 (paddle movement, arrow keys): game/paddle.gd (movement input), game/main.gd (adds input actions).
  - 3,4 (balls drop and bounce): game/main.gd (spawns balls), game/ball.gd (movement, wall/paddle bounce).
  - 5 (spin): game/ball.gd (rotates sprite).
  - 6 (score on bounce): game/ball.gd emits signal bounced -> game/main.gd increments score.
  - 7,8,9 (lives start 3, lose life on miss, display): game/main.gd (lives state, UI, missed signal from ball).
  - 10,11 (win/lose print): game/main.gd prints "WIN" or "GAME OVER" with final score on state change.
  - 12 (R to restart): game/main.gd handles Input to reset state.
  - 13 (Esc to quit): game/main.gd handles quit input.

- State ownership:
  - Main.gd owns global game state: score:int, lives:int, state:String ("playing"/"win"/"game_over"), list of active balls:Array[Node].
  - Paddle.gd owns paddle position and movement speed.
  - Ball.gd owns per-ball velocity:Vector2, angular_velocity:float and handles its own movement and collision checks; it emits signals to Main for scoring/misses.

- Interfaces:
  - Ball.gd:
    - signal bounced()
    - signal missed()
    - func reset(position:Vector2, velocity:Vector2) -> void
  - Main.gd:
    - func spawn_ball() -> void
    - func _on_ball_bounced(ball:Node) -> void
    - func _on_ball_missed(ball:Node) -> void
  - Paddle.gd:
    - export var speed:float
    - no public returns; position read via its global position.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Viewport origin (0,0) at top-left. Positive y down. Sprite nodes are centered. Paddle is placed near bottom center. Ball radius is 16 (sprite 32x32).

- Lifecycle transitions:
  - init (_ready): setup input actions, UI, spawn timer, initial state score=0, lives=3.
  - play: balls spawn, move down, bounce on walls/paddle. On bounce, score++.
  - miss: when ball.y > viewport_height + margin, lives-- and ball removed. If lives==0 -> GAME OVER state and print.
  - win: when score >=15 -> WIN state and print. In terminal states input R resets state (reset score/lives/remove balls), Esc quits via get_tree().quit().

Now I'll write initial files: __init__.py, project.godot, main.tscn and main.gd. After that I'll run a syntax check.

func _on_ball_missed(ball: Node) -> void:
